items.html: But know that just as ZA has internal and surrounding brains, so too the internality of this Vav of SAG includes internal and surrounding. For the externality of the two parts mentioned above became internal within the ten lower parts of this Vav, of the phase of internality; but the internality of the two parts mentioned, which also became internal within the three upper parts of this Vav, and it is found that they are two within three, and their entirety becomes one Hey. And this Hey becomes the phase of surrounding brains over this Vav.
